title: I asked Fable 5.2 to build a SNES game
author: shiny_guruw
selftext:
Hello All!

I am the creator of [ppu.toys](http://ppu.toys) \- An AI enabled super nintendo development studio that gives you and your agents the power to create real Super Nintendo games.

With Fable 5.2 coming out yesterday, I knew I needed to let it have full reign over my machine and the studio to see what it would create. The prompt was brief, I did not mention a genre or a specific art style, I told it about [ppu.toys](http://ppu.toys) and the art tools I had installed on my machine. \[full prompt is in the video description on youtube\]

With nothing more than the initial prompt, 4 hours 46 minutes and $72 dollars worth of credits - I got Emberwake.

What's most impressive to me is that Fable 5.2 was able to read the docs off of [ppu.toys](http://ppu.toys) and quite successfully built a team of Agents all on its own to create the assets and the music, while the main agent wrote the code and dealt with the studio.

The quality of the assets Fable 5.2 built in this experiment far exceeds what I have been able to produce with any other agent driving the studio. 

Fable 5.2 also had a lot of good feedback for the actual dev experience of the site as well and I actually had to iron in some hot patches for it as it hit some obscure bugs. 

Overall, given the cost - I don't think I will continue with Fable 5.2 as my daily driver. But for asset generation, I have to say this experiment seems quite promising!
